items.headline: Medtronic quarterly revenue rises 9.9% to $9.81 billion and EPS reaches $1.55; company raises quarterly dividend to $0.72 per share (3.1% yield)
Medtronic revenue up 9.9% year over year to $9.81 billion and earnings $1.55 per share, slightly exceeding analyst estimates; quarterly dividend raised to $0.72 (3.1% yield)
